beast-ball.name: Beast Ball
beast-ball.short_desc: Tries to catch a wild Pokemon. Success rate is 5 for Ultra Beasts and 0.1 for all other Pokemon.
beast-ball.desc: Used in battle : Attempts to catch a wild Pokemon. If the wild Pokemon is an Ultra Beast, this ball has a catch rate of 5. Otherwise, it has a catch rate of 0.1. If used in a trainer battle, nothing happens and the ball is lost.
beast-ball.flavor_text: A somewhat different Poke Ball that has a low success rate for catching a Pokemon.

cherish-ball.name: Cherish Ball
cherish-ball.short_desc: Tries to catch a wild Pokemon.
cherish-ball.desc: Used in battle : Attempts to catch a wild Pokemon, using a catch rate of 1. If used in a trainer battle, nothing happens and the ball is lost.
cherish-ball.flavor_text: A quite rare Poke Ball that has been crafted in order to commemorate a special occasion of some sort.

dive-ball.name: Dive Ball
dive-ball.short_desc: Tries to catch a wild Pokemon. Success rate is 3.5 when underwater, fishing, or surfing.
dive-ball.desc: Used in battle : Attempts to catch a wild Pokemon. If the wild Pokemon was encountered by surfing or fishing, this ball has a catch rate of 3.5. Otherwise, it has a catch rate of 1. If used in a trainer battle, nothing happens and the ball is lost.
dive-ball.flavor_text: A somewhat different Poke Ball that works especially well when catching Pokemon that live underwater.

dream-ball.name: Dream Ball
dream-ball.short_desc: Catches Pokemon found in the Dream World.
dream-ball.desc: Can only be used in Entree Forest, to catch Pokemon encountered in the Dream World. Used in battle : Catches a wild Pokemon without fail.
dream-ball.flavor_text: A somewhat different Poke Ball that makes it easier to catch wild Pokemon while theyre asleep.

dusk-ball.name: Dusk Ball
dusk-ball.short_desc: Tries to catch a wild Pokemon. Success rate is 3.5 at night and in caves.
dusk-ball.desc: Used in battle : Attempts to catch a wild Pokemon. If its currently nighttime or the wild Pokemon was encountered while walking in a cave, this ball has a catch rate of 3.5. Otherwise, it has a catch rate of 1. If used in a trainer battle, nothing happens and the ball is lost.
dusk-ball.flavor_text: A somewhat different Poke Ball that makes it easier to catch wild Pokemon at night or in dark places such as caves.

fast-ball.name: Fast Ball
fast-ball.short_desc: 4 effectiveness on Pokemon with 100 or greater base speed. (Gen II: Roaming or Fleeing Pokemon). Made from Wht Apricorn.
fast-ball.desc: Used by a trainer in battle : Attempts to catch a wild Pokemon. If used in a trainer battle, nothing happens and the ball is lost. : If the wild Pokemons base speed is 100 or more, its catch rate is 4 normal.
fast-ball.flavor_text: A Poke Ball that makes it easier to catch Pokemon that are usually very quick to run away.

friend-ball.name: Friend Ball
friend-ball.short_desc: Caught Pokemon start with 200 happiness. Made from Grn Apricorn.
friend-ball.desc: Used by a trainer in battle : Attempts to catch a wild Pokemon. If used in a trainer battle, nothing happens and the ball is lost. If caught, the wild Pokemons happiness starts at 200.
friend-ball.flavor_text: A strange Poke Ball that will make the wild Pokemon caught with it more friendly toward you immediately.

great-ball.name: Great Ball
great-ball.short_desc: A better ball with a higher catch rate than a Poke Ball.
great-ball.desc: A good, high-performance Poke Ball that provides a higher catch rate than a standard Poke Ball.
great-ball.flavor_text: A good, high-performance Poke Ball that provides a higher success rate for catching Pokemon than a standard Poke Ball.

heal-ball.name: Heal Ball
heal-ball.short_desc: Tries to catch a wild Pokemon. Caught Pokemon are immediately healed.
heal-ball.desc: Used in battle : Attempts to catch a wild Pokemon, using a catch rate of 1. The caught Pokemons HP is immediately restored, PP for all its moves is restored, and any status ailment is cured. If used in a trainer battle, nothing happens and the ball is lost.
heal-ball.flavor_text: A remedial Poke Ball that restores the HP of a Pokemon caught with it and eliminates any status conditions.

heavy-ball.name: Heavy Ball
heavy-ball.short_desc: Has flat bonus or penalty to catch rate depending on weight class of target. Made from Blk Apricorn.
heavy-ball.desc: Used by a trainer in battle : Attempts to catch a wild Pokemon. If used in a trainer battle, nothing happens and the ball is lost. If the wild Pokemon weighs: * 409.6 kg (903.0 lb) or more, its catch rate is 40 more than normal. * 307.2 kg (677.3 lb) or more, its catch rate is 30 more than normal. * 204.8 kg (451.5 lb) or more, its catch rate is 20 more than normal. * less than 204.8 kg (451.5 lb), its catch rate is 20 less than normal.
heavy-ball.flavor_text: A Poke Ball that is better than usual at catching very heavy Pokemon.

lafeather-ball.name: Feather Ball
lafeather-ball.flavor_text: Can be thrown further than a regular Poke Ball. Is more effective for catching Pokemon that fly high in the air.

lagigaton-ball.name: Gigaton Ball
lagigaton-ball.flavor_text: Upgraded version of the Leaden Ball. Doesn't fly far, but is more effective if the Pokemon hasn't noticed the player.

laheavy-ball.name: Heavy Ball
laheavy-ball.flavor_text: Doesn't fly far, but is more effective if the Pokemon hasn't noticed the player.

lajet-ball.name: Jet Ball
lajet-ball.flavor_text: Can be thrown further than a Wing Ball. Is more effective for catching Pokemon that fly high in the air.

laleaden-ball.name: Leaden Ball
laleaden-ball.flavor_text: Upgraded version of the Heavy Ball. Doesn't fly far, but is more effective if the Pokemon hasn't noticed the player.

lawing-ball.name: Wing Ball
lawing-ball.flavor_text: Can be thrown further than a Feather Ball. Is more effective for catching Pokemon that fly high in the air.

level-ball.name: Level Ball
level-ball.short_desc: Success rate based off of fraction target Pokemon is of users Pokemon. Made from Red Apricorn.
level-ball.desc: Used by trainer in battle : Attempts to catch a wild Pokemon. If used in a trainer battle, nothing happens and the ball is lost. If the trainers Pokemons level is higher than: * four times the wild Pokemons, the wild Pokemons catch rate is 8 normal. * than twice the wild Pokemons, the wild Pokemons catch rate is 4 normal. * the wild Pokemons, the wild Pokemons catch rate is 2 normal.
level-ball.flavor_text: A Poke Ball that makes it easier to catch Pokemon that are at a lower level than your own Pokemon.

love-ball.name: Love Ball
love-ball.short_desc: 8 effectiveness on opposite sex, same species targets of the Active Pokemon. Made from Pnk Apricorn.
love-ball.desc: Used by a trainer in battle : Attempts to catch a wild Pokemon. If used in a trainer battle, nothing happens and the ball is lost. If the trainers Pokemon and wild Pokemon are of the same species but opposite genders, the wild Pokemons catch rate is 8 normal.
love-ball.flavor_text: A Poke Ball that works best when catching a Pokemon that is of the opposite gender of your Pokemon.

lure-ball.name: Lure Ball
lure-ball.short_desc: 3 effectiveness while fishing. Made from Blu Apricorn.
lure-ball.desc: Used by trainer in battle : Attempts to catch a wild Pokemon. If used in a trainer battle, nothing happens and the ball is lost. If the wild Pokemon was encountered by fishing, the wild Pokemons catch rate is 3 normal.
lure-ball.flavor_text: A Poke Ball that is good for catching Pokemon that you reel in with a rod while out fishing.

luxury-ball.name: Luxury Ball
luxury-ball.short_desc: Tries to catch a wild Pokemon. Caught Pokemon start with 200 happiness.
luxury-ball.desc: Used in battle : Attempts to catch a wild Pokemon, using a catch rate of 1. Whenever the caught Pokemons happiness increases, it increases by one extra point. If used in a trainer battle, nothing happens and the ball is lost.
luxury-ball.flavor_text: A particularly comfortable Poke Ball that makes a wild Pokemon quickly grow friendlier after being caught.

master-ball.name: Master Ball
master-ball.short_desc: Catches a wild Pokemon every time.
master-ball.desc: Used in battle : Catches a wild Pokemon without fail. If used in a trainer battle, nothing happens and the ball is lost.
master-ball.flavor_text: The best Poke Ball with the ultimate level of performance. With it, you will catch any wild Pokemon without fail.

moon-ball.name: Moon Ball
moon-ball.short_desc: 4 effectiveness on familes of Pokemon with a Moon Stone evolution. Made from Ylw Apricorn.
moon-ball.desc: Used by trainer in battle : Attempts to catch a wild Pokemon. If used in a trainer battle, nothing happens and the ball is lost. If the wild Pokemon is a Clefairy, Nidoran, Nidoran, Jigglypuff, Skitty, or any evolution thereof, the wild Pokemon has 4 its catch rate.
moon-ball.flavor_text: A Poke Ball that will make it easier to catch Pokemon that can evolve using a Moon Stone.

nest-ball.name: Nest Ball
nest-ball.short_desc: Tries to catch a wild Pokemon. Success rate is 3.9 for level 1 Pokemon, and drops steadily to 1 at level 30.
nest-ball.desc: Used in battle : Attempts to catch a wild Pokemon. Has a catch rate of given by `(40 - level) / 10`, where `level` is the wild Pokemons level, to a maximum of 3.9 for level 1 Pokemon. If the wild Pokemons level is higher than 30, this ball has a catch rate of 1. If used in a trainer battle, nothing happens and the ball is lost.
nest-ball.flavor_text: A somewhat different Poke Ball that becomes more effective the lower the level of the wild Pokemon.

net-ball.name: Net Ball
net-ball.short_desc: Tries to catch a wild Pokemon. Success rate is 3 for water and bug Pokemon.
net-ball.desc: Used in battle : Attempts to catch a wild Pokemon. If the wild Pokemon is Water- or Bug-type, this ball has a catch rate of 3. Otherwise, it has a catch rate of 1. If used in a trainer battle, nothing happens and the ball is lost.
net-ball.flavor_text: A somewhat different Poke Ball that is more effective when attempting to catch Water- or Bug-type Pokemon.

park-ball.name: Park Ball
park-ball.short_desc: Catches Pokemon in the Pal Park every time.
park-ball.desc: Used by a trainer in battle : Catches a wild Pokemon. This item can only be used in Pal Park.
park-ball.flavor_text: A special Poke Ball for the Pal Park.

poke-ball.name: Poke Ball
poke-ball.short_desc: A basic ball used to catch wild Pokemon.
poke-ball.desc: A basic Poke Ball used to catch wild Pokemon.
poke-ball.flavor_text: A device for catching wild Pokemon. Its thrown like a ball at a Pokemon, comfortably encapsulating its target.

premier-ball.name: Premier Ball
premier-ball.short_desc: Tries to catch a wild Pokemon.
premier-ball.desc: Used in battle : Attempts to catch a wild Pokemon, using a catch rate of 1. If used in a trainer battle, nothing happens and the ball is lost.
premier-ball.flavor_text: A somewhat rare Poke Ball that was made as a commemorative item used to celebrate an event of some sort.

quick-ball.name: Quick Ball
quick-ball.short_desc: Tries to catch a wild Pokemon. Success rate is 4 (Gen V: 5), but only on the first turn.
quick-ball.desc: Used in battle : Attempts to catch a wild Pokemon, using a catch rate of 4 on the first turn of a battle, but 1 any other time. If used in a trainer battle, nothing happens and the ball is lost.
quick-ball.flavor_text: A somewhat different Poke Ball that has a more successful catch rate if used at the start of a wild encounter.

repeat-ball.name: Repeat Ball
repeat-ball.short_desc: Tries to catch a wild Pokemon. Success rate is 3 for previously-caught Pokemon.
repeat-ball.desc: Used in battle : Attempts to catch a wild Pokemon. If the wild Pokemons species is marked as caught in the trainers Pokedex, this ball has a catch rate of 3. Otherwise, it has a catch rate of 1. If used in a trainer battle, nothing happens and the ball is lost.
repeat-ball.flavor_text: A somewhat different Poke Ball that works especially well on a Pokemon species that has been caught before.

safari-ball.name: Safari Ball
safari-ball.short_desc: Tries to catch a wild Pokemon in the Great Marsh or Safari Zone. Success rate is 1.5.
safari-ball.desc: Used in battle : Attempts to catch a wild Pokemon, using a catch rate of 1.5. This item can only be used in the Great Marsh or Safari Zone.
safari-ball.flavor_text: A special Poke Ball that was used in the Safari Zone in the Kanto region and in the Great Marsh in the Sinnoh region.

sport-ball.name: Sport Ball
sport-ball.short_desc: Tries to catch a Pokemon in the Bug-Catching contest in National Park. (Gen II: Park Ball)
sport-ball.desc: Used by a trainer in battle : Attempts to catch a wild Pokemon. The wild Pokemons catch rate is 1.5 normal.
sport-ball.flavor_text: A special Poke Ball that was used during the Bug-Catching Contest in the Johto region.

timer-ball.name: Timer Ball
timer-ball.short_desc: Tries to catch a wild Pokemon. Success rate increases by 0.1 (Gen V: 0.3) every turn, to a max of 4.
timer-ball.desc: Used in battle : Attempts to catch a wild Pokemon. Has a catch rate of 1.1 on the first turn of the battle and increases by 0.1 every turn, to a maximum of 4 on turn 30. If used in a trainer battle, nothing happens and the ball is lost.
timer-ball.flavor_text: A somewhat different Poke Ball that becomes progressively more effective at catching Pokemon the more turns that are taken in battle.

ultra-ball.name: Ultra Ball
ultra-ball.short_desc: Tries to catch a wild Pokemon. Success rate is 2.
ultra-ball.desc: Used in battle : Attempts to catch a wild Pokemon, using a catch rate of 2. If used in a trainer battle, nothing happens and the ball is lost.
ultra-ball.flavor_text: An ultra-high-performance Poke Ball that provides a higher success rate for catching Pokemon than a Great Ball.
